heading.title: Special Provisions Relating to the 1[high Courts 2[not Being the Court of a Judicial Commissioner]

article.title: Application of Code to High Courts.
article.content:
117Application of Code to High Courts.

Section 117
Save as provided in this Part or in Part X or in rules, the provisions of this Court shall apply to such High Courts.
